newsitem.title: USA: American Eagle pilots approve single pact.
newsitem.headline: American Eagle pilots approve single pact.

text.p: Navigators for AMR Corp's regional carrier, American Eagle, approved a single contract covering all 1,900 pilots flying for the four carriers operating under the Eagle banner, the Air Line Pilots Association said.
The union said that 62 percent of the ballots cast were in favor of ratification of the agreement, a modified version of an agreement that was rejected two weeks ago.

The agreement covers the four wholly owned operating carriers that fly as American Eagle: Simmons Airlines, Flagship Airlines, Executive Airlines and Wings West. The four won the right to bargain as a single carrier for representational purposes in August 1995.
Terms of the pact were not immediately available.
